description:
## The most political party of the year

An afternoon and night of workshops, dinner, bands, spoken word and DJs at Het Groene Veld in Amsterdam. We bring the roda de samba, together with Kiala & The Afroblaster and more.

## Good to know

- From 16:00 until 02:00.
- Ticket details coming soon.
